newsitem.title: UK: Syria cuts April Light crude by 45 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Syria cuts April Light crude by 45 cts - trade.

text.p: Syria's state oil company Sytrol has agreed a 45-cent cut in the price of its Light crude oil for April lifting, traders said on Monday.
Sytrol had agreed a discount of 95 cents to international benchmark Dated Brent, described by traders as its lowest differential ever. Sytrol agreed a 50-cent discount in March.
Negotiations were continuing over the April value of Syrian heavy Souedie, the traders said.
Sytrol had opened price talks with offers of Dated Brent -78 cents for Syrian Light and Dated Brent -$4.60 for Souedie.
Contract lifters responded with bids of Dated -$1.10/-$1.15 for Syrian Light and Dated -$5.00/-$5.25 for the heavier grade.
